identity.name: Inventory Sorter CSR Compatibility
aliases: Inventory Sorter × Container Slot Reservations Compatibility

goals: Fill CSR-reserved physical slots only from reservation-valid unreserved donors, then keep every reservation anchored outside Inventory Sorter's ordinary workspace while preserving normal order and stack behavior for all remaining movable slots.
Sort every unreserved shulker box and bundle as an ordinary outer ItemStack without inspecting, reconstructing, or mutating portable-container contents or components.
Suppress Inventory Sorter's optional sort-into-bundles content-insertion pass while preserving ordinary server, client fallback, and player inventory sorting.
scope: Canary 3 intercepts only Inventory Sorter 3.0.0's ContainerInventorySorter whole-range layout/writeback seam, ClientFallbackSortPlanBuilder fallback-click seam, and PlayerInventorySorter bundle-insertion entrypoint.

Before layout, one shared deterministic planner visits reservation targets and unreserved donors in physical slot order. It requires CSR's exact ContainerSlotReservationsApi.mayInsert admission, ordinary ItemStack component-compatible merging for occupied targets, and effective container/menu capacity; wrong/full occupants remain untouched and reserved slots are never donors.

CSR detection and admission use the exact Container or Slot.container plus Slot#getContainerSlot local index; CSR resolves supported physical owners, component-exact templates, specific portable-container identities, native writability, and double-container mappings.

After reservation fill, a masked range compacts only non-reserved slots through Inventory Sorter's own SortedInventoryLayout, writes or clicks only their original physical/menu slots, and never uses a CSR-reserved slot as general workspace.

Client fallback emits only explicit donor-to-reservation pickup sequences for planned fills, restores donor remainders, then invokes Inventory Sorter's click planner with only the simulated post-fill unreserved slots.

A bundle triggers only the narrow ordinary-layout bypass that removes Inventory Sorter's bundle-target content insertion; the outer bundle remains in the movable pool on server and client fallback paths.
The player's special upstream sort-into-bundles branch is replaced only when its main inventory contains a bundle; a shulker alone keeps the upstream player path.

exclusions: Does not modify, bundle, redistribute, or copy source/resources from Inventory Sorter or Container Slot Reservations.
Does not change CSR reservation data, insertion admission, hopper, QUICK_MOVE, QSN, CCAR, manual interaction, comparator rules, or supported-owner policy.
Does not intercept broad vanilla inventory APIs; it acts only inside audited Inventory Sorter sort entrypoints.
Exact Inventory Sorter and CSR JAR versions are controlled-validation and bytecode-contract baselines, not exact runtime dependency pins.
